integrity: All finite counts are obtained by exhaustive enumeration of all 512 subsets of the nine-point poset, exact lower-set tests, and explicit recursive beat-point reductions. The literature comparison distinguishes prior existence statements from the new maximal-open and uniqueness classification.
scientific_limitations: The classification is specific to the displayed labelled nine-point space \(P(9)\); it does not assert the analogous census for the order dual, ten-point examples, or arbitrary finite spaces.
title: The minimal nine-point weakly contractible core \(P(9)\) has exactly two maximal contractible opens
